agreement_summary: An eleven-month rent agreement dated 1 October 2025 for the second floor of House 21, Lane 4, Ganga Vihar. The rent is Rs. 14,000 a month and clause 3 says that figure already includes maintenance. Clause 9 says either side must give one month's written notice to end the agreement, and that neither side may end it on shorter notice.

claims.claim: Clause 9 allows the landlord to end the tenancy on seven days' notice
claims.notice_quote: As per clause 9 of the rent agreement, seven days' notice is sufficient for termination of the tenancy by the landlord
claims.agreement_quote: Either party may terminate this agreement by giving to the other one month's notice in writing.
claims.explanation: Clause 9 requires one month's written notice from either party, and adds that neither party may terminate on shorter notice. The notice gives seven days.

claims.claim: Maintenance of Rs. 3,000 a month is payable separately, over and above the rent
claims.notice_quote: which is payable by you separately and over and above the monthly rent
claims.agreement_quote: The monthly rent stated in clause 2 is inclusive of all maintenance charges for the said premises, and no separate maintenance charge shall be demanded by the Landlord
claims.explanation: Clause 3 states the rent already includes all maintenance and that no separate maintenance charge may be demanded during the agreement.

claims.claim: The tenancy began under an agreement executed on 1 October 2025
claims.notice_quote: as my tenant under a rent agreement executed between us on 1 October 2025
claims.agreement_quote: The tenancy shall commence on 1 October 2025 and shall subsist for a period of eleven months
claims.explanation: Both documents give the same start date for the tenancy.

claims.claim: The security deposit may be adjusted against the arrears
claims.notice_quote: The security deposit shall be adjusted against the arrears and any damage to the premises
claims.agreement_quote: to be refunded at the time of handing over vacant possession after adjustment of any arrears of rent or the cost of repairing damage caused by the Tenant
claims.explanation: Clause 4 allows the deposit to be adjusted against arrears of rent and the cost of repairing damage.

claims.claim: The tenant is liable for mesne profits for unauthorised occupation
claims.notice_quote: you shall be liable for mesne profits for the period of unauthorised occupation together with all costs
claims.explanation: The agreement says nothing about mesne profits or compensation for occupation after the tenancy ends.
